H2-Q2: Valentinian I made infanticide a capital offence in 374. "Valentinian I. in 374 assimilated infanticide to other forms of murder, and made it a capital offence." [PDF p. 173]

H2-Q3: No, the passage states that slavery was not extinguished for centuries. "Though slavery was not extinguished for centuries, its evils were immensely modified." [PDF p. 173]

H2-Q4: Oman regarded it as dangerous because men retired from their duties as citizens and ceased to be useful to society. "When men retire from their duties as citizens... cease to be of the slightest use to society, the result may be harmless so long as their numbers are small." [PDF p. 174]
